reviews.content: I tested it—the idea is really nice, but I can't find a place where I like how the folder icons are placed. It would be REALLY nice if each folder acted like an individual app so I could place it wherever I want in the taskbar (just like any other app, allowing me to change the order and all that). It is REALLY nice, and I hope it gets there soon because I want to start using it so bad. Nice work!
